page_title: LearnClash: The Quiz Duel That Makes You Smarter

sources.entry: LearnClash - AI-powered 1v1 quiz duels on any topic with ELO rankings and spaced repetition. Free, no ads.

summary.name: LearnClash
summary.one_liner: LearnClash is a free 1v1 quiz duel app where you compete against a real opponent or an AI rival on general knowledge or chosen topics, with explanations after each answer and spaced repetition for missed questions.
use_cases: Quiz yourself on general knowledge against a friend
Review and retain questions you got wrong
Learn a new topic through explained answers
Play short trivia rounds during spare minutes
Create a custom quiz topic to study
Practice trivia against an AI rival when no opponent is available
summary.what_it_does: LearnClash runs 1v1 trivia duels where you answer questions against a friend, a matched player, or one of six labeled AI rivals. Each duel is 18 questions over 6 rounds, with 45 seconds per question and a 72-hour window per turn. After every answer you can read why it is right and ask Clash, the AI tutor, follow-up questions. Missed questions return after 7 days and again after 90 days once answered correctly. Players can pick from hundreds of topics or create new ones, with questions generated on demand.
notable: Turn-based 1v1 duels against real players, with a 72-hour window per turn
Built-in 3-stage spaced repetition that resurfaces missed questions after 7 and 90 days
Explanation after every answer plus an AI tutor (Clash) for follow-ups
Playable in the browser with no signup; no ads in any tier
caveats: Premium costs $7.99 per month or $59.99 per year and unlocks unlimited Solo sessions, more tutor messages, private topics and more duels per turn
Free tier limits Clash tutor follow-ups to 30 starter messages, then 1 per 24 hours
Free for ages 13 and up only
